decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): On its own, the cited note [ev-11bb4ca0844c] is too vague to decide the open aspects. However, the same telemetry section spells the change out in [ev-7e3267b542c5]: CEL expressions in the telemetry API must now use standard Envoy attributes. Peer metadata moves from filter_state["wasm.downstream_peer"] and filter_state["wasm.upstream_peer"] to filter_state.downstream_peer and filter_state.upstream_peer, node metadata moves from node to xds.node, and Wasm attributes must be fully qualified (for example filter_state["wasm.istio_responseClass"]). That is enough to write applicability (environments whose telemetry API or extension CEL expressions use the old attribute names) and consequence (those expressions no longer use the required vocabulary, so they need rewriting; has() is offered for setups that mix old and new proxies), though the exact failure mode is implied rather than stated and the link between the two notes is inferred, hence low confidence.
